task: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml] .github/workflows/codeql.yml dosyasındaki medyan 62 saniyelik CodeQL code scanning darboğazını gidermek için pip ve apt adımlarına `actions/cache` eklenerek bağımlılık indirme süreleri kısaltılmalı, yalnızca ilgili dosya değişikliklerinde çalışması için `paths` filtreleri yapılandırılmalı ve birbirine bağımlı olmayan test adımları paralel job'lara bölünerek toplam pipeline süresi optimize edilmelidir.

evidence.detail: Target workflow file .github/workflows/codeql.yml identified for CodeQL scanning bottleneck optimization, dependency caching, path filtering, and job parallelization.

factual_findings: The workflow file requiring optimization is .github/workflows/codeql.yml.
The proposed optimizations target the median 62-second CodeQL bottleneck by introducing actions/cache for pip/apt dependencies, path filtering for trigger conditions, and parallel job splitting.
hypotheses: Integrating actions/cache for pip and apt dependencies in .github/workflows/codeql.yml will decrease setup time across workflow executions.
Adding path filters (`paths`) to on.push and on.pull_request in .github/workflows/codeql.yml will avoid running CodeQL scans when non-code files (such as documentation) are modified.
Decomposing monolithic workflow jobs into independent parallel jobs will optimize overall pipeline runtime.
result.recommendation: Modify .github/workflows/codeql.yml to add actions/cache for package managers, configure `paths` triggers for relevant source files, and split independent steps into parallel GitHub Actions jobs.
result.next_action: Update .github/workflows/codeql.yml with the caching, path filtering, and job parallelization changes.
